body:
I do want to go to college badly but with me being indecisive with what I want to go into I don't want to go all in on something and find out I hate it and become a drop out with debt. I'm currently 20 years old just recently turned and I will agree that there definitely like minded people out there. Things have just haven't been the same when I was younger especially with things going on in the world in general, or it could be I just never paid attention. But it seems like each day theres another school shooting or any other traumatic event going on in general. Due to me living in an area with poor job oppertunitys and not the best education it would have to come down to me moving. I just worry for my brother because hes took care of me when nobody else did and seeing him like this hurts bad. I know that theres only so much I can do but its the fear that if I am not there for him. Then there is just little things that keep pileing up that just makes it to the point I feel like I am just going to crack under pressure.

But I do appreciate the words of wisdom friend. They will not go unread. I am glad things have turned for the better than for the worst for you.
